  MINUTES
  SENIOR, CITIZEN COMMISSION
  MEETING

  Thursday, May 4, 2023

  San Dimas Senior Citizen/ Community Center Meeting Room

Call to Order: The meeting was called to order at 6: 00 pm

Present-  Wally Nikowitz, Chairperson
  Nancy Brewster
  Sean Cazares
  Karl Janssen
  Frida, Sarehraz

Also Present:  Emmet Badar, Mayor

  Chris Constantin, City Manager
  Joseph Jones, Parks &  Recreation Manager
  Orlando  Soto, Recreation  Coordinator
  Paige Rode, Departmental  Assistant

Absent:  Bill Beebe
  Pamla Johnson,  Co- Cliaiiperson

Audience Members:  Laura Brantley, District Representative for Senator Susan Rubio.

Recognitions/ Presentations:  NONE

Oral Communication:  NONE

  1,  Staff Report

  Mr. Soto highlighted Senior events and programs, He reported that. Monthly Dinners were sold
  out in March and April with 96 participants each, There were 168 AARP tax appointments in
  March and 79 in April, YWCA served 183 participants 3, 660 meals in March and 1. 73
  participants were served 3, 664 meals in April.

  Mr. Soto reported that beginning the week of May 15, YWCA will return to dine - in n-leals
  Monday -Friday. The last day for the Wednesday Grab and Co Meals will be May 1. 0,

  Mr. Soto invited members of the Commission to the Senior Volunteer Recognition on May
  25"

  2.  Approval of Minutes March 2, 2023 Meeting
  COMMISSIONER  BREWSTER  MOTIONED  TO APPROVE  THE MARCH  2, 2023 MINUTES,
  SECONDED  BY COMMISSIONER  CAZARES  AND PASSED  UNANIMOUSLY,
   A.  Future Resource/ Financial Seminar Topics

  Chairperson Nikowitz asked if there were any updates on Senior Solutions to schedule a
  seminar.

  Commissioner Janssen stated that she is willing to assist with finding seminars,
  Cornmissioner Nikowitz suggested seminars be scheduled on a day other than Tuesday,
  so they don' t compete with Bingo.

  B.  Future  Capital  Improvement  Projects

  Chairperson Nikowitz stated the Commission should begin thinking about suggestions for
  next years budget,
  C.  Senior Services  Strategic Plan

  Chairperson Nikowitz discussed the promotion of free gym memberships for seniors
  through their health plans.

  Mr. Soto discussed the Senior Regional Games in Pasadena.

  Mr. Soto stated the next new program for Senior Sports will be a Cornhole Tournament.

  J. Travel Club

  Commissioner Brewster reported that there doesn' t seem to be much interest in starting a
  Travel Club at San Dimas  Senior Center.

  E.  Older American  Recognition
  Mr, Soto reported that Carolyn Gomm, the Older American Honoree, will be

  recognized at the May 9"' City Council. Meeting, She will also be recognized at the
  LA County Virtual event on May 25' 11.

  F. Senate Bill Discussion: SB- 17, SB- 20, SB- 37
  Commissioner Cazares discussed SB- 17 and SB- 37.

  Chairperson Nikowitz inquired about the proposed project on Foothill.

  Mr. Constantin stated the housing project proposed for 740 E. Foothill is being
  planned as all age supportive housing. The City recommends, if it is to be built, it
  be for homeless seniors.

  Ms. Brantley discussed SB- 20 and the Sail Gabriel Valley Housing Trust.

  Mr. Constantin stated the City signed a.]. I million dollar, 5 - year contract with
  L.A. CADA for homeless services. ' The team is in the community 4- days a week
  offering assistance and emergency housing to homeless individuals.

4.  Senior Citizen Commission  Foundation
  A.  Foundation Treasury Report
   The Columission Foundation Financial Statement showed the total account balance as
  13, 706- 84,

  B.  Senior Center Purchase  Request
  1.
  Coffee Pots for Senior Center and Plumnier Building
  2.  PA System for Plummer Building

  Mr. Constantin stated the Foundation funds are on hold and no expenses will be
  approved until the account is audited, There may be fees involved to bring the account
  in full compliance  with the state,

  Mr. Jones stated the City can purchase the 2 coffee pots for the Senior Center and said
  the City is currently looking into replacing the PA system at the Plummer Building.
5.  Continued  Items: NONE

6.  Written Communication:  NONE

8.  Report  of Members:
  A.  Chair Report

  Chair Nikowitz stated that his term on the Commission was expiring.

  Mr. Constantin responded that the current Commissioners will be extended by
  2- teens, The Council, will meet again to discuss City Comnfissions,

  C.  Commissioner Reports
  Commissioner Cazares reported on upcoming Chamber of Commerce events,

  Commissioner Sarehraz stated that she is on the Senior Club Scholarship Con-mrittee.
  The Senior Club has a budget of $10, 000. 00for scholarships. They are currently
  Interviewing students and reviewing the applications,

  Commissioner Janssen stated that she has been visiting senior events and activities in other
  cities to see what they offer compared to San Dimas,

  Commissioner Brewster stated that she may further investigate a Senior Travel Club,

  MGM

  The meeting was adjourned at 7: 30p.m.
  Next meeting for the Senior Commission will be July 6,, 2023
